constants.GROUNDING_RETRY_NOTE: (Your previous answer stated times, numbers or dates that are not in any tool result. Call the relevant tool first and answer only from what it returns.)
constants.UNGROUNDED_REPLY: I couldn't confirm the details of that answer against your saved data, so I've held it back rather than guess. Please ask again — I'll read your tasks, habits and calendar first.
constants.UNGROUNDED_REPLY_WORK: I couldn't confirm the details of that answer against your organization's data, so I've held it back rather than guess. Please ask again — I'll read the project and task details first.
constants.LOOKUP_LIMIT: I reached the limit for data lookups in one reply. Please ask a more focused question.
